<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex045042026-03-2013-18-28" status="reviewed">3 pa bshad tshul 2 <abbr>gsung</abbr> pa'i dgos pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">sngon gyi mkhas mchog phya pa <abbr>chen po</abbr></rs> laswo pas ¦ <abbr>grags</abbr> pa la <abbr>2 te</abbr>: brda'i grags pa dang ¦ tha snyad kyi <abbr>grags</abbr> pa 2 ¦ 
               <abbr>de dag</abbr> sgrub par byed <abbr>pa'i</abbr> <abbr>gtan tshigs</abbr> kyang <abbr>2 te</abbr> | 
               <abbr>gzhan</abbr> sel phyin ci log <lb n="106b4"/> <abbr>pa'i</abbr> sgras zhen su sgrub pa la <abbr>phyogs chos</abbr> dang khyab pa tshang ba'i <abbr>rtags</abbr> ni ¦ tha snyad kyi <abbr>grags</abbr> pa sgrub <abbr>pa'i</abbr> <abbr>rtags</abbr> yin la de yang <abbr>mtshan nyid</abbr> de'i khyas bya <abbr>rtags su</abbr> byas mtshon bya sgrub pa ste ¦ nogs lkog shal dang ldan pas ba lang gi tha <abbr>snyad dang</abbr> ¦ sha pas shing gi tha snyad sgrub pa laswo pa'o || 
               <abbr>gzhan</abbr> sel phyin ci ma log pas <lb n="106b5"/> <abbr>khyad par</abbr> du <abbr>ma byas</abbr> <abbr>pa'i phyir</abbr> sgra tsaM gyi <abbr>rjes dpag</abbr> rung sgrub pa la <abbr>phyogs chos</abbr> dang khyab pa tshang pa'i <abbr>rtags</abbr> ni ¦ brda'i grags pa sgrub <abbr>pa'i</abbr> <abbr>rtags</abbr> te ¦ 
               de la'ang 2 : sgra'i dngos kyi brjod bya sgrub pa la <abbr>phyogs chos</abbr> dang khyab pa tshang ba'i <abbr>rtags</abbr> dang ¦ sgra'i zhen <abbr>pa'ii</abbr> brjod bya sgrub pa la <abbr>phyogs chos</abbr> dang khyab pa tshang pa'i <abbr>rtags so</abbr> | <!--Phya pa's position continues up to the refutation by Sa pan, 107a3--></seg></TEI>
